maddeler.e:
التحمن (form VIII)
# اِلْتَحَمْنَ (iltaḥamna) /il.ta.ħam.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِلْتَحَمَ (iltaḥama)
# اُلْتُحِمْنَ (ultuḥimna) /ul.tu.ħim.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِلْتَحَمَ (iltaḥama)
# اِلْتَحِمْنَ (iltaḥimna) /il.ta.ħim.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِلْتَحَمَ (iltaḥama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
